notes: Card flags dense (13% of tokens over 0.1 max) and gate-closed (-g +u leak), max only 1.99. Top peaks are ordinary nouns after a verb or adjective (' students', ' physician', ' local', ' Muscle'). Best guess; expected to fail, recorded to document the density.
